title: Bookkeeping
description: For school leavers who want to keep proper business records or offer bookkeeping to small businesses. Learn receipts and invoices, the cash book, double entry, ledgers, a simple trial balance and spreadsheet bookkeeping.
outcomes: Explain why accurate records matter to a business
Write clear receipts and invoices and file source documents
Keep a cash book with a running balance and separate sales and expense records
Record transactions using double entry, post them to ledgers and draw up a simple trial balance
Use a spreadsheet to keep books and prepare a monthly summary
Offer basic bookkeeping as a paid service to small businesses
